Expand a file destination template string

Source: R/utils.R
expand_file_destination.Rd

Expand a file destination template string

Usage

expand_file_destination(file_destination, source_config)

Arguments

file_destination

A file destination template string, which can include tokens such as project_root, years, vintage, or state.

source_config

A source configuration list containing values to fill the file_destination template string.

Value

A path string using the template and pre-filled values.
